mof_ops.detail: No switch, buyback or T-bill auction in the windows (14-28 May). May plan (30 Apr): no switch auctions; the only T-bill auction (46-week, 8 May) is pre-window. MoF DB shows no wholesale operations between 14 and 28 May other than the 21 and 27 May sales.

In-window May sales incl. additional: 21 May 10,041.75m + 27 May 10,257.205m = 20298.955m. The 13 May sale (other agent) raised ~11.85bn incl. additional (PAP weekly 18 May 06:20), so May regular supply ~32.1bn. Financing of 2026 gross borrowing needs: ~51% of the record PLN 688bn after 13 May (Millennium 14 May 08:45) -> ~54% (MoF to PAP Biznes, Skrot 25 May 17:02; ING 27 May: financing pace slowed in recent weeks as the war worsened issuance conditions) -> Millennium 28 May: >50% of planned domestic SPW issuance financed. June supply plan: NOT published by 28 May (PAP calendar: Fri 29 May 15:00) - not used.

MoF estimate (gov.pl; PAP Skrot 15 May 17:01): central budget deficit after April PLN 89,294.3m. PKO 18 May: 30.1% of the annual limit; Jan-Apr revenue +6.0% y/y, expenditure +3.2%; 12-month rolling deficit ~273bn vs the 272bn limit; CIT +18% YTD (bank CIT rate hike), VAT ~-0.2% y/y and excise -4.7% in April (CPN package); debt service +60% y/y YTD. Erste 18 May: 91.4bn a year earlier (72.9bn comparable, ex 18.5bn bond buyback); April revenue +6.0% y/y, VAT +0.2%, expenditure +11.5%, CIT +27.3%. MoF (PAP 18 May 07:21): capital expenditure after March 9.77bn = 13.4% of the 73.03bn plan.

digest.2026-05-15: 14 May: Q1 GDP flash 3.4% y/y (consensus 3.6%), 0.5% q/q, weighed down by the frost. MPC's Wnorowski: rates should stay on hold at least until July, and CPI above 3.5% would not trigger an automatic hike. ING: the market prices 75bp of hikes within 12M; Pekao: the 2Y swap is at its 4.50% high. BGK sold 0.84bn of FPC bonds (demand 1.10bn) plus 0.15bn additional. OK0129 trades from 18 May. Domanski: windfall-tax details within a week. POLGB yields fell 3-13bp on Gulf calm; DS0436 5.85%.
digest.2026-05-18: 15-17 May: April CPI final 3.2% y/y (flash). The budget deficit after April was 89.3bn (30.1% of the limit). March C/A was -0.23bn EUR, far better than -1.26bn expected. MoF FX on accounts EUR 16.5bn. Scope affirmed Poland at A and moved the outlook to Negative (15 May). The PM refused to countersign NBP board appointments of Kotecki, Litwiniuk, Zarzecki and Kightley. Fri 15 May: global sell-off, SPW +17-22bp, 10Y 5.96% (DS0436 ~6%), swaps +10-15bp. Economists: CPI above 3.5% shuts cuts and raises hike odds; most still see a hold.
digest.2026-05-19: 18 May: April core inflation 3.0% y/y (0.9% m/m, as expected). Glapinski (Bloomberg): the MPC makes no commitments; the economy is resilient and CPI within the band. Erste: hike pricing of up to 100bp in a year is exaggerated; Millennium: FRA +5-25bp on 15 May, IRS above March highs. GPW Benchmark will end WIBOR from 2037; KNF: no new WIBOR contracts after 2026. MoF sale on 21 May (offer due Tue). SPW 0-6bp lower; 10Y briefly above 6%, closing ~5.96%.
digest.2026-05-20: 19 May: MoF cut the 21 May offer to 6-10bn (OK0129, NZ0331, PS0731, DS1034, DS0436, NZ0936) from 7-13bn in the plan. The windfall-tax bill is due in Q2: 75% of margin above the 2025 level +20%. Erste: CPI near 4% from May to Q1 2027, risks shift toward hikes. DB: hold at 3.75% through December. BGK filed a EUR 35bn MTN prospectus. PKO's Budzicki: supply may weigh, but there is room to 4.6% (2Y) and 5.8% (10Y). Yields flat; DS0436 6.00%.
digest.2026-05-21: 20 May: the WZ coupon for 25 May-25 Nov is 3.96% (WIBOR 6M 3.97/3.96/3.96%). MoF mandated BNP/UBS for a CHF issue. Tyrowicz: 3.75% is too low. Consumer confidence improved (BWUK -11.3); GUS inflation expectations eased to 24.7. HICP 3.4%. State Treasury debt 2,088.8bn (+1.9% m/m). Trigon: the windfall tax could cost Orlen ~6bn. SPW -11-12bp as oil dipped; the 10Y fell back below 6% (DS0436 5.93%). ING: the smaller offer helps.
digest.2026-05-22: 21 May: MoF sold 10.0bn (offer 6-10bn, demand 13.3bn) plus 0.04bn additional; PS0731 4.6bn at 5.43%, DS0436 1.8bn at 5.88%. MoF priced CHF 885m (3Y/7Y/10Y green, MS+50/80/90bp), its first CHF deal since 2015. April data were soft: wages 5.4% (6.0% expected), industry 3.1% (4.1%). Construction beat at 4.5% and PPI at 1.9% (-0.1%). EC: 2026 deficit 6.5% of GDP, debt 64.5%, GDP 3.5%. SPW flat to +1bp; DS0436 5.89%.
digest.2026-05-25: 22-24 May: NBP: Tyrowicz's April motion for a 100bp hike was rejected (all others against). GUS May business climate stable or better. Motyka: decision on extending CPN next week. PKO: Thursday's auction and weak data helped SPW; Erste: weak data trimmed hike bets. MoF: CHF buyers mostly Swiss funds. BOS: CPI not durably above 3.5%. Fri 22 May: SPW -1-5bp, 10Y ~5.85-5.88%, DS0436 5.84%.
digest.2026-05-26: 25 May: retail sales +1.3% y/y (consensus 3.5%); M3 11.3%. MoF: 2026 financing ~54%; it offers 7-11bn on 27 May (incl. DS1033). Domanski: CPN probably extended. Erste: FRA 9x12 -27bp w/w, one hike priced out; Millennium: ~2 hikes left by year-end. BGK plans FPC switches from June and a POLSTR floater in Q3. Next KPO request ~EUR 8bn in late June. SPW -8-10bp as Brent fell below $100; DS0436 5.75%.
digest.2026-05-27: 26 May: unemployment 6.0%; LFS 3.3%; orders +1.7% y/y; GUS composite 98.5. S&P's Vartapetov: fiscal position, with no medium-term consolidation, is the key rating risk for Poland. Motyka: CPN to at least mid-June. BNP: CPI ~4% at end-2026. BGK set its 28 May FPC tender (min 0.5bn). Overnight US strikes on Iran; IRS -8-9bp and FRA -5-9bp (Erste), bonds broadly flat; DS0436 5.76%. DB: core supports an H2 hike.
digest.2026-05-28: 27 May: MoF sold 10.1bn (offer 7-11bn, demand 12.7bn) plus 0.14bn additional; PS0731 4.1bn at 5.29%, DS0436 3.1bn at 5.74%, DS1033 1.6bn at 5.45%. GPWB 29 May change: DS0436 joins TBSP (19 bonds) and B5Y; PS0527 leaves 1-3Y/1-4Y/1-5Y; NZ0331/NZ0928 join BWZ. TBSP YTM 4.97%, mod dur 3.68. EC to pay a EUR 7.2bn KPO tranche next week. Business inflation expectations fell. SPW little changed; DS0436 5.74%.
digest.2026-05-29: 28 May: fuel VAT/excise cuts extended to 15 June (Dz.U.). BGK sold FPC for 0.94bn (demand 1.62bn) plus 0.05bn additional. Tusk: first 40 SAFE contracts worth PLN 100bn by 30 May. May ESI 100.1. Banks: the 27 May sale had solid demand but little market impact; >50% of domestic issuance done. SPW +1-3bp early, then PLN firmed (~4.227/EUR) after reports of a US-Iran 60-day MoU awaiting Trump's approval; DS0436 5.76%. May CPI flash and June supply plan due 29 May.

mpc.gist: Context only (recapped in PKO/Erste/Millennium 14 May): Litwiniuk - a hike more likely than a cut by end-2026, July projection opens the debate, no July hike, almost nobody favours hikes now; Kotecki - forget cuts until mid-2027, stability most likely, hike talk possible from July.
Worries more about growth than inflation; no hasty decisions; rates unchanged at least until July barring extraordinary events; even CPI >3.5% should not trigger an automatic or immediate reaction.
PM Tusk returned without countersignature the President's appointments of Marta Kightley and MPC members Kotecki, Litwiniuk and Zarzecki to the NBP board.

Tyrowicz's motion for a 100bp hike rejected, all other members against; all rates held on 8-9 Apr (reference 3.75%).

No minutes (opis dyskusji) seen in the PAP feed 14-28 May; minutes of the 5-6 May meeting are due after the next meeting. Next MPC 1-2 June (BPS 18/25 May). Glapinski's 6 May remark that hike odds have risen is pre-window (recalled in the PAP weekly of 25 May).
Independent monetary policy is beneficial; MPC policy fits the cycle better than ECB rates would.
